estimand: Mean of per-reference-CpG m/(C+m+h) within each window, equal CpG weights; call-weighted fraction provided separately
read_scope: All source reads; no family word gate or independent noncatalog anchor prerequisite
coordinate_scope: Exact concordance of both CpG bases across all returned AS>=0.8 primary alignments; heuristic, not exhaustive genomic uniqueness
display: CpGs>=10 and distinct window read IDs>=3; NaN gaps break lines; valid zero retained; >=5 subset marks same mean

coordinate_example.scope: Targeted example, not a global coordinate-accuracy estimate

spatial_flag: longest no-valid-CpG interval > half actual window length OR no CpG in central half
support: Counts apply to whole windows, not uniform depth at every CpG; overlapping windows share measurements
